newsitem.title: USA: General Mills buys back 150,000 shrs in Q3.
newsitem.headline: General Mills buys back 150,000 shrs in Q3.

text.p: General Mills Inc said Wednesday it repurchased 150,000 shares in its fiscal third quarter, bringing its nine-month total to 3.9 million shares repurchased.
During the quarter, General Mills issued about 5.4 million shares in its acquisition of the branded cereal and snack business of Ralcorp Holdings Inc.
After that transaction closed, General Mills said, it renewed its share repurchases, consistent with a previously stated goal of reducing shares by one to two percent annually.
Third quarter average shares outstanding totaled 157.5 million shares, down 1.7 million from 159.2 million a year ago.
